name: ecommerce-product-research
description: Research products and prices from your AI agent across Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, Lazada and any Shopify store, and find suppliers on AliExpress and Alibaba. Compare one product's price everywhere, check Amazon sellers and Best Sellers, audit a competitor store's catalog, discounts and apps, and estimate sourcing margins. Pay per result on your Apify account.

interface.longDescription: Research products and prices from your AI agent across Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, Lazada and any Shopify store, and find suppliers on AliExpress and Alibaba. Compare one product's price everywhere, check Amazon sellers and Best Sellers, audit a competitor store's catalog, discounts and apps, and estimate sourcing margins. Pay per result on your Apify account. Includes 5 skills (competitor-store-audit, ecommerce-cost-estimate, price-check, product-research, product-sourcing) and Apify's hosted MCP server limited to Imzlab's Actors. After installing, run `codex mcp login ecommerce-research` to sign in to Apify in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Compare the price of the De'Longhi EC685 on Amazon, Walmart, Target and Google Shopping.
Audit allbirds.com: price range, discounts, newest products and the apps it uses.
Find Alibaba suppliers for silicone kitchen utensil sets and estimate my margin on Amazon.
